verdict: Leads are coming in; Google's spend is producing zero measurable results.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 36 leads at an average cost per lead of $104.87, all of them driven by Meta — Google Ads spent $1,996.57 and recorded zero conversions. That zero is a confirmed tracking failure, not a sign that the ads aren't reaching people; conversion tracking is being repaired now so spend can be properly measured and optimized. On the local search side, your Google Business Profile generated 131 actions this period — 28 calls, 65 direction requests, and 38 website clicks — and activity surged 33% in the most recent week, a positive signal. Once tracking is restored, expect a clearer picture of what Google Ads is actually delivering and the ability to shift budget toward what's working.
